Dashboard Methodology & User Reference

This report compiles historical and real-time product issues, tracking them relative to actual shipping volumes to prevent high-volume products from overshadowing quality signals. Here's how to interpret the data:

  • Row-wise Heat Scale: Within each product's row, green shows its best performing month, yellow shows moderate rates, and red indicates its peak historical issue rate. This allows quick diagnostic checks of internal quality improvements or setbacks.
  • BP Care & BP Xpert Split: In June 2026, Kapiva upgraded BP Care to the new formulation BP Xpert. BP Care data is locked up to May-26, and BP Xpert begins active tracking from June-26.
  • Spike Alerts: A product triggers a spike alert if its latest month's complaint rate exceeds 1.5x its historical average, and the rate is above 0.25%.
  • Filter Synchronization: All KPI cards, charts, and drill-down tables are bound to the filters above. Remarks and batches automatically reflect the selected filters. Note: Order counts represent total monthly shipped orders, so filtering complaints by customer details (origin, repeat status) compares that specific complaints subset to the total orders in that month.
